verdict.rationale: BILL clearly ships a versioned API (v3) with a dedicated 'why upgrade to v3' migration doc and changelog entries (e.g., webhook subscription limits), showing some version-lifecycle documentation, but there is no explicit deprecation policy, sunset timeline, or versioning-support commitment in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit deprecation/sunset policy documentation, version support timelines, and any communicated end-of-life process for older API versions.
